digest.component_or_area: DC outbound comment and description length convergence testing
propositions: DC lacks convergence suites for oversized comments and descriptions that would verify truncated values converge on second pass without re-emission
DC's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description truncation to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) via a shared fit function, but the coupling and its correctness are undocumented

The comment ceiling 32767 is established as correct for DC >= 7.0 by Jira's jira.text.field.character.limit property default and JRASERVER-28519, not by assumption or measurement, but this provenance is not cited in source

DC convergence tests must explicitly inject the DC backend (sanitizer for comments, outbound/inbound mappers and links for descriptions) to avoid silently falling back to Cloud's backend via config, which would produce vacuous green tests

DC and Cloud truncation differ in units (DC uses plain character count at 32767; Cloud uses ADF-serialized size at 32000) and must not be parametrized together without restructuring Cloud's incident-hardened tests
